eval_dimensions.name: Criteria Resolution
eval_dimensions.description: Loads plugin-default checks for the work type, applies repo overrides (remove/replace/add), and filters by active modes

eval_dimensions.name: Check Execution
eval_dimensions.description: Runs each automated check, resolves {pr_number}/{repo} placeholders, evaluates expect/expect_contains/expect_gt fields, and reports a pass/fail table

eval_dimensions.name: Merge-Gated Completion Gate (GH-729)
eval_dimensions.description: Never offers or auto-selects 'Work complete' while an associated PR is open/unmerged; recommends background review-monitoring instead; reserves completion for the merged (or PR-less) state

eval_dimensions.name: Scope-Deferred Review Threads (GH-736)
eval_dimensions.description: Honors review-deferred mode by skipping the unresolved-threads and review-request checks so the DoD reflects the agreed scope; never recommends 'Work complete' while a blocking check is failing

eval_dimensions.name: Live-State work_type Re-Inference (GH-780)
eval_dimensions.description: When the caller passes a PR-less work_type (local-only/investigation) but an open PR exists, unions the feature check set (CI, draft, fixup, threads, review) into the loaded checks rather than trusting the thin plan-time checklist

eval_dimensions.name: Single Verification Baseline (GH-1172)
eval_dimensions.description: Runs one baseline on every project: all automated checks run, every `manual` check is converted to a `prompt` Claude evaluates, and no friction level is read or honoured. A playbook step cannot dial this layer up or down.

eval_dimensions.name: Resolver / Recommendation Boundary (ADR-0016)
eval_dimensions.description: resolve_gate decides whether the completion_signoff gate FIRES (ask / auto-advance / skip); this skill decides which option it RECOMMENDS. Neither overrides the other — an auto-advance still takes the recommendation computed here, and a Go back stays Go back under every effect.

evals.name: open-pr-recommends-monitor-not-complete
evals.prompt: /Dev10x:verify-acc-dod feature  (session: resolve_gate returns effect 'ask' for completion_signoff; all automated checks pass; PR #42 is OPEN and awaiting review)
evals.description: Tests that when every acceptance criterion passes but the associated PR is open/unmerged, the gate recommends 'Monitor for review' (routing to Dev10x:gh-pr-monitor) and NOT 'Work complete'.
evals.expected_output: AskUserQuestion fires with 'Monitor for review (Recommended)' as the first option, routing to Dev10x:gh-pr-monitor. 'Work complete' is NOT offered as the recommended option while PR #42 is unmerged.

assertions.text: Resolves PR merge state via pr_detect / verify_pr_state before deciding the gate
Recommended option is 'Monitor for review' routing to Dev10x:gh-pr-monitor
'Work complete' is NOT the recommended/auto-selected option while the PR is open/unmerged

evals.name: auto-advance-open-pr-auto-starts-monitor
evals.prompt: /Dev10x:verify-acc-dod feature  (session: resolve_gate returns effect 'auto-advance' for completion_signoff, active_modes [solo-maintainer]; all checks pass; PR #42 OPEN, unmerged)
evals.description: Tests that when the resolver auto-advances the completion gate with an open/unmerged PR, the skill takes the SAME recommendation the boundary computed — auto-starting the background monitor instead of auto-completing — and the residual terminal task becomes 'Monitor PR #N for review / merge'.
evals.expected_output: No 'Work complete' auto-completion. Skill(Dev10x:gh-pr-monitor) is dispatched in the background; the residual task is 'Monitor PR #42 for review / merge'. No AskUserQuestion interruption.

assertions.text: Does NOT auto-complete 'Work complete' while the PR is open/unmerged
Dispatches Dev10x:gh-pr-monitor in the background

evals.name: merged-pr-allows-work-complete
evals.prompt: /Dev10x:verify-acc-dod feature  (session: resolve_gate returns effect 'ask' for completion_signoff; all checks pass; PR #42 is MERGED)
evals.description: Tests that once the PR is merged (or the work is PR-less), the gate offers/auto-selects 'Work complete' as before.
evals.expected_output: AskUserQuestion offers 'Work complete (Recommended)' because PR #42 is merged.

assertions.text: 'Work complete' is the recommended option once the PR is merged

evals.name: review-deferred-skips-thread-check
evals.prompt: /Dev10x:verify-acc-dod bugfix  (session: resolve_gate returns effect 'auto-advance' for completion_signoff, active_modes [solo-maintainer, review-deferred]; CI green, working copy clean, PR #42 OPEN; two review threads remain unresolved)
evals.description: Tests that with review-deferred active, the unresolved-threads and review-request checks are removed from scope (reported as skipped), so the gate resolves honestly to Monitor for review instead of staying red — and is NOT papered over as 'Work complete'.
evals.expected_output: The 'No unresolved review threads' and 'Re-review requested' checks are reported as 'skipped (mode: review-deferred)'. Remaining checks pass, PR #42 is open → recommendation is 'Monitor for review' (background gh-pr-monitor). 'Work complete' is NOT recommended.

assertions.text: Removes the 'No unresolved review threads' check from scope and reports it as skipped (mode: review-deferred)
Does NOT recommend/auto-select 'Work complete' on the strength of skipping the deferred check while the PR is still open

evals.name: local-only-open-pr-unions-feature-checks
evals.prompt: /Dev10x:verify-acc-dod local-only  (session: a local-only plan resolved 'create PR' mid-execution, so PR #42 is now OPEN and unmerged)
evals.description: Tests that a local-only invocation with an open PR present re-infers from live state and executes the feature PR checks (CI passing, PR not draft, no unresolved review threads) instead of only the thin local-only checklist.
evals.expected_output: pr_detect resolves the open PR #42; the feature check set is unioned into the local-only checks (deduped by name). The run executes 'CI passing', 'PR not draft', and 'No unresolved review threads', and reports the added checks as 'added by live-state re-inference'. The caller's 'Working copy clean' check is preserved, not duplicated.

assertions.text: Resolves the open PR via pr_detect before finalizing the check list
Executes the feature PR checks (CI passing, PR not draft, No unresolved review threads) even though the caller passed local-only
Reports that checks were added by live-state re-inference rather than silently reducing coverage
Does NOT duplicate the caller's 'Working copy clean' check when unioning

evals.name: supervisor-review-none-skips-review-checks
evals.prompt: /Dev10x:verify-acc-dod bugfix  (session: resolve_gate returns effect 'auto-advance' for completion_signoff, active_modes [solo-maintainer]; supervisor_review_status reports supervisor_review 'none'; review-deferred NOT set; CI green, working copy clean, PR #42 OPEN; two review threads remain unresolved)
evals.description: Tests the ADR-0019 path as renamed by ADR-0022 D-2: the durable, project-wide supervisor_review: none posture removes every check declaring requires_human_review from scope, reported as skipped (supervisor_review: none). This is the sanctioned replacement for the deprecated review-deferred mode, which targeted the retired session.yaml and so was never read back in a configured repo (GH-950). Eval 4 keeps covering the deprecated mode for back-compat.
evals.expected_output: The 'No unresolved review threads' and 'Re-review requested' checks are reported as 'skipped (supervisor_review: none)' — resolved from the requires_human_review field in defaults.yaml, not from active_modes. Remaining checks pass, PR #42 is open → recommendation is 'Monitor for review' or the merge path. 'Work complete' is NOT papered over on the strength of the skip while the PR is unmerged.

assertions.text: Resolves the posture via supervisor_review_status rather than reading friction.yaml directly or the retired .claude/Dev10x/session.yaml
Removes the checks declaring requires_human_review: true from scope and reports each as skipped (supervisor_review: none)
Derives WHICH checks to skip from the requires_human_review field in defaults.yaml, not from a hardcoded list in SKILL.md
Does NOT recommend/auto-select 'Work complete' on the strength of the skip while PR #42 is still open and unmerged

evals.name: manual-checks-are-judged-not-asked
evals.prompt: /Dev10x:verify-acc-dod investigation  (no PR; the only default check is 'Findings documented', declared check: manual)
evals.description: Tests the GH-1172 single baseline: a `manual` check is converted to a `prompt` Claude evaluates from session context, on every project. There is no per-item AskUserQuestion and no friction level that would restore one.
evals.expected_output: 'Findings documented' is evaluated from session context and reported pass/fail with a brief rationale. No AskUserQuestion is fired for the manual item. No friction level is read, asked for, or defaulted.

assertions.text: Evaluates the manual check contextually and reports a rationale rather than queueing it for user confirmation
Does NOT fire AskUserQuestion to confirm the manual check
Does not read, request, or default a friction level anywhere in the run

evals.name: resolver-cannot-turn-go-back-into-complete
evals.prompt: /Dev10x:verify-acc-dod feature  (session: resolve_gate returns effect 'auto-advance' for completion_signoff; PR #42 is MERGED but 'Working copy clean' FAILS — the tree is dirty)
evals.description: Tests the resolver/recommendation boundary from the failing side: the resolver decides only whether the gate fires, never which option wins. With a blocking check red, the recommendation is 'Go back' even though the PR is merged and the gate auto-advances.
evals.expected_output: The recommendation is 'Go back' (a blocking check failed), and auto-advance takes THAT option — reporting the failing 'Working copy clean' check to the parent orchestrator. 'Work complete' is not auto-selected on the strength of the merged PR.

assertions.text: Resolves the recommendation to 'Go back' because a blocking check failed, independent of the resolver's effect
Auto-advance takes the computed recommendation rather than substituting 'Work complete'
Treats resolve_gate as deciding only whether the gate fires, not which option it recommends
